about: Southgate is a township in Grey County, Ontario, centred on Dundalk—not a city, and not Southgate in other provinces. Dundalk sits on the Dundalk Highlands, among the highest inhabited ground in southern Ontario, with hamlets such as Proton Station and Holstein in surrounding farmland. About 9,000 people live in Southgate Township.
